generate.title: New routine
generate.subtitle: The plan is generated from what you set here. All of it is editable afterwards.
generate.name: Name
generate.nameRequired: Give it a name to save it.
generate.nameDuplicate: You already have a routine with that name.
generate.sessionsHint: A number of sessions, not weekdays.
generate.minutesHint: The time you actually have, warm-up included.
generate.capacityAutoError: The recommendation could not be calculated. Please try again.
generate.alternativeHint: Optional evaluated alternative: {{sessions}} training days, {{sets}} sets. Same exercises and exact direct/indirect muscle volume, within your time limit and the modeled recovery checks. Your requested days remain unchanged unless you apply it.
generate.alternativeUnavailable: This dose leaves short sessions. No fewer-day arrangement passed the time, concentration and recovery checks with the same exercises and sets. Your requested days are kept; no filler sets have been added.
generate.scheduleAllocationReview: There is enough total dose for the requested days, but its distribution still needs review. Fewer days are not offered as a substitute for fixing that allocation.
generate.capacityAutoHint: Compare practical schedules for the estimated targets. More days are not always better.
generate.capacityAutoResult: Suggested: {{sessions}} sessions of {{minutes}} min, approximately {{sets}} sets per microcycle.
generate.capacityAutoLimited: The starting targets are not fully covered by this estimate ({{sets}} sets). Generate the plan to review the limitations.
generate.capacityBudget: Approximately {{perSession}} sets per session ({{total}} per microcycle). The generated plan may use fewer.
generate.splitAutoHint: Adapts the structure to volume, time, and fatigue between sessions.
generate.emphasisHint: Tap a region to prioritise it, again to leave it on maintenance.
generate.blockedSlotBudget: This priority exceeds the configured recovery capacity.
generate.previewOverTime: The edit exceeds the available time in sessions {{sessions}}.
generate.previewUnderfilled: Sessions {{sessions}} have fewer than {{minimum}} working sets. Consider fewer sessions or edit the plan; extra sets are not added just to fill time.
generate.previewOutsideVolume: The edit puts total volume outside the reference range.
generate.rerollUnchanged: No compatible alternative was found with the same volume and constraints. Your plan has been kept.
generate.rerollEdited: Your manual edits have been kept. Use individual exercise swaps to keep the edited volume.
generate.planStale: You changed the settings. Generate again to apply them.
generate.previewLimitedByTime: TIME is the limit. More sessions or more minutes would fit more sets.
generate.previewLimitedByRecovery: The estimated volume budget fits your available time. Your recovery capacity still needs to be observed in training.
generate.previewLimitedByInsufficientTime: Not enough time for a useful session. Raise the minutes.
generate.strengthNoBarbell: You did not select a barbell. The main strength lifts were replaced by the closest alternative; with a barbell the block would be more specific.
generate.previewTopSingle: Starts with a heavy single at RPE 8
